blocking.issue: G0 states two incompatible conditions: pass at >=4 bps, red at smaller-than-costs-by-more-than-3x (<1.33 bps). The 1.33-4 bps band has no verdict. No minimum number of qualifying levels and no precision requirement, while the far cheaper G2 demands n>=100 and >=5 days.

Step 0.0 depends on 0.1-0.3 but needs the level rule from 1.1, classification from 1.2 and the markout baseline from 2.1; it also skips lob verify, and the rolling-hour percentile of H3 does not exist during the first hour of a one-hour pilot.
No rule for time-aligning a REST snapshot with the WS book, so zero mismatches is unachievable by construction; and no pre-registered rule for a verify failure on the already-recorded week.
Clustering by UTC day with 7 days gives 5-7 clusters: CRVE is downward-biased and one-sided t=3 on 6 df is p~0.012 not 0.001. No module owns or tests the clustered statistic.
Step 4.1 produces the RTT that gates G4 but has no module, no subcommand, no test, no entry in Contracts touched, and needs HMAC-SHA256 signing and API keys that no dependency or step provides.
